"""Sanitized actual candidate publication and final serving quiescence readback."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
base = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional')
bundle = base / 'component-evidence-e49e149-07833c71'
out = {'observed_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'executions': {}, 'candidates': {}, 'canonical': {}}
image = 'us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/adi-anvil-mvp-2026/anvil-qa-v1/kyc-runtime@sha256:cbd37c0a896f3b6e7e49bf53b5721297ae3bad08dedc9f00b0b36ce48ba4fe7c'
for name in ('forge-components-verify-f71b7abe', 'forge-components-publish-ce0683ec'):
    info = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', name], timeout=15))[0]
    cleanup = json.loads((bundle / (name + '.cleanup.json')).read_bytes())
    intent = json.loads((bundle / (name + '.intent.json')).read_bytes())
    assert info['Id'] == cleanup['id'] and info['Config']['Image'] == image
    assert info['Config']['Labels'].get('io.adi.forge.operation') == name
    assert info['State']['Pid'] == 0 and not info['State']['Running'] and not info['State']['Restarting'] and info['State']['ExitCode'] == 0
    assert cleanup['complete'] and cleanup['canonical_unchanged'] and not cleanup['failures']
    out['executions'][name] = {'id': info['Id'], 'image': image, 'image_id': info['Image'], 'intent': intent, 'cleanup': cleanup,
        'state': {key: info['State'][key] for key in ('Running', 'Restarting', 'Pid', 'ExitCode', 'OOMKilled')},
        'host_config': info['HostConfig'], 'mounts': info['Mounts'], 'user': info['Config']['User'], 'env_values_redacted': True}
for name, path, pin in (
    ('component', base / 'harbor-proof/component-qualification-candidate-e49e149/current.json', '05ee9325ada9634653a22f47a9d84195127f943f661e9a8ca8a4f0805034a482'),
    ('capture', base / 'capture-database-qualification-candidate-e49e149/current.json', 'ec98eb6bcacdbb16217227d43a37fa7359169c8190e4dc4cf4aa5120a505acff')):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == pin
    body = json.loads(raw)
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(body['expires_at'].replace('Z', '+00:00')) > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    out['candidates'][name] = {'sha256': pin, 'receipt': body}
for name, path, pin in (
    ('component', base / 'harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json', '634fc636eb4df0c5fe265457a006f42ab7900b71ad739907ac38b808b48e41a1'),
    ('capture', base / 'capture-database-qualification/current.json', 'dcad1e15003676eac58cacef48f56624990b05e791de2bf21d877632b5afdfa7'),
    ('compose', Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/config/compose-app.json'), '48ca71dac9acea4e3650452474d4c6ce23a8eece847be556b50c274dd68ec5bc')):
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pin
    out['canonical'][name] = pin
out['unresolved_bridge_attempts'] = []
for directory in ('native-control-bridge', 'private-grading-bridge'):
    for path in (base / directory).iterdir():
        if path.is_dir() and (path / 'request.json').exists() and not any((path / name).exists() for name in ('completion.json', 'failed.json', 'result.json')):
            out['unresolved_bridge_attempts'].append(path.name)
assert not out['unresolved_bridge_attempts']
command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.commands),(SELECT count(*) FROM banking.execution_jobs)"'
out['commands_execution_jobs'] = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'exec', 'anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1', 'sh', '-c', command], timeout=15).decode().strip()
assert out['commands_execution_jobs'] == '0|0'
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
